services.label: DeepSeek
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys
services.defaultModelReason: The cheaper of its two models, both calling tools; the docs' own examples name it (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing).
notes: Base URLs: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/ (OpenAI) and https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/anthropic_api (Anthropic).
Prices are the zh-cn page's in CNY, at the peak rates (Beijing time Mon-Fri 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00); off-peak rates are half. The English page lists USD prices for the same models.
deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner were discontinued on 2026-07-24 (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates).
No error is documented for an exceeded context window, and none for a timeout.

models.note: Context and output from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/list-models; the aliases are legacy ids the service routes to it.

services.label: OpenAI
services.defaultModelReason: The docs' choice 'to balance intelligence and cost' (GPT-6 Astra is the flagship; GPT-6 Luna is 'for cost-sensitive, high-volume workloads'); it calls tools over Responses, the default endpoint (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models).
notes: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6.1 Terra take Chat Completions but call tools only through Responses; GPT-6 Luna calls tools on Chat Completions only with reasoning_effort none (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model). Responses is the default endpoint.
Prompts over 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output.
The model list (GET /v1/models) includes embedding, image and audio models.

services.label: Anthropic
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys
services.defaultModelReason: 'Speed and capability for everyday coding, agent, and enterprise workloads', with agentic tool use; Opus 5.5 is the flagship and Haiku 5.5 is meant for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as classification and routing (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/choosing-a-model).
notes: The docs give the window as 1M and the output as 128K (Sonnet 5.5's 128,000 written out); GET /v1/models reports the exact values.
Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.2 refuse a forced tool_choice; Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 always think.
cacheWrite is the 5-minute cache write; a 1-hour write costs more.

price.tier: prompts up to 100,000 tokens; over that 0.50 / 0.05 / 2.50, write 0.625

services.label: Google Gemini
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
services.defaultModelReason: The stable Flash model, with function calling, which the OpenAI-compatible endpoint's own examples use; Gemini 4 is the costlier tier and 3.5 Flash-Lite is scoped to subagent tasks and document parsing (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash).
notes: Gemini 4's prices double on 2026-12-01 (4.00 / 0.20 / 20.00) and Gemini 3.8 Flash's on 2027-01-01 (1.50 / 0.15 / 7.50): both are in the data with the day they take effect.
Gemini 4 caps one non-streaming answer at 32,768 tokens (65,536 streaming).
The list's ids are read without a models/ prefix should the list have one (its output is not documented).
The error pages describe the native APIs; none covers the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

services.label: xAI
services.defaultModelReason: 'Fast, reliable model with strong tool calling and instruction following capabilities', cheaper than grok-4.7 (https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.3).
notes: Chat Completions is a legacy endpoint there; new features come to Responses first (https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/legacy/chat-completions).
Prompts of 200K tokens or more are billed at twice these rates. The prices are the global endpoint's; the US endpoint costs 10% more, and its profiles have no price here.
The model pages state no output limit; no error is documented for a balance, a context window, a server error or a timeout (https://docs.x.ai/developers/debugging).

services.label: OpenRouter
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://openrouter.ai/keys
notes: It routes other services' models (author/model ids); their facts and prices are in its live list (GET /api/v1/models), which this file does not copy.
A failure after the model has started comes with HTTP 200, in the body or as a stream event.

services.label: Groq
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://console.groq.com/keys
services.defaultModelReason: The faster and cheaper of the two, for low-latency agentic and tool-augmented applications (https://console.groq.com/docs/model/openai/gpt-oss-20b).
notes: The model list includes speech and guard models; ids carry their author (openai/gpt-oss-120b).

services.label: Moonshot (Kimi)
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://platform.kimi.com/console/api-keys (international: https://platform.kimi.ai/console/api-keys); the two sites' keys are not interchangeable
services.defaultModelReason: Its current flagship, and cheaper than the previous one (kimi-k3); the highspeed model is the same model faster, at twice the price (https://platform.kimi.com/docs/models.md).
notes: Prices from the China site in CNY (cn) and the international site in USD (global, https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat). cacheWrite is the 5-minute write.
K3 models always think, and take temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 and n 1 only.
The output limit is the documented ceiling of max_completion_tokens (131072 by default); the service lowers it to the context left.

services.label: Zhipu (GLM)
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://bigmodel.cn/usercenter/proj-mgmt/apikeys (international: https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list)
services.defaultModelReason: Priced at a tenth of GLM-5.3 ('GLM-5.3-Flash 定价为 GLM-5.3 的 1/10'), with function calling (https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/models/vlm/glm-5.3-flash.md).
notes: No model list is documented: the models offered are those below.
The window is given as 1M (read here as 1,000,000). GLM-5.3 and its Flash models always think: thinking.type disabled is refused.
Prices from the China site in CNY (cn) and from Z.ai in USD (global, https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing.md). A Coding Plan key uses its own base (/api/coding/paas/v4).

services.label: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen)
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key (international: https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/ap-southeast-1/settings/api-key); a key works only in the region it was made in

services.defaultModelReason: Described as fast and low-cost ('快速且低成本'; Plus balances performance and cost), with function calling (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/models).
notes: The documented base is now an account's own (https://{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1), which these hosts take too; the dashscope hosts get no new features after 2026-09-30.
Its insufficient_quota is a tokens-per-minute limit, not an empty balance; an empty balance is Arrearage (400).
qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-flash keep their thinking in history (preserve_thinking on by default).

No OpenAI-compatible model list is documented: the models offered are those below. Prices from the Beijing region in CNY (cn) and Singapore in USD (global, the International deployment); a workspace host in another region has no price here. Singapore's cache price for qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-flash is only in the console, so their cached input is billed at the input price.

prices.tier: prompts up to 256K tokens; up to 1M: 1.2 / 0.24 / 4.8; the implicit cache reads at 20% of input (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/context-cache)

services.label: Volcengine Ark (Doubao)
services.defaultModelReason: The cheapest of the four, with function calling and the highest rate limits; doubao-seed-evolving changes every week (https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310).
notes: Its K is 1024 tokens (the model list's own numbers). max_tokens (the answer, without the chain of thought) defaults to 4096 (https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1494384; the model list's '最大回答(默认 4K)'), so requests ask for 32768 (requestOutputTokens), well under each model's 256K answer limit; max_completion_tokens (1 to 65536, the chain of thought included) would lift it too. The DeepSeek models it hosts default to 131072.
OutofContextError is documented only for requests with pictures. BytePlus ModelArk, its international service, has other model ids and is not in this file.

services.label: MiniMax
services.defaultModelReason: Its everyday model ('日常高效主力模型'), an agentic model with tool use, cheaper than M3 (https://platform.minimax.cn/docs/guides/text-generation).
notes: Its error codes come in the body (base_resp.status_code); the page does not say with which HTTP status, so they are read only from a call that failed.
Thinking cannot be turned off; temperature and top_p are fixed. Prices from the China site in CNY (cn) and the international site in USD (global, https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview).

prices.tier: prompts up to 512K tokens, after a permanent 50% off; over: 0.60 / 0.12 / 2.40

services.label: SiliconFlow
services.keyHint: Create an API key at https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak (international: https://cloud.siliconflow.com/account/ak)
services.defaultModelReason: The only one of the three tagged as a general assistant ('通用助手'), with tools; GLM-5.2 is a costlier flagship and Kimi-K2.7-Code is for code (https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/open/models).
notes: It hosts other makers' models under their ids (author/model); its list (GET /v1/models) includes image, audio and embedding models.

Output limits from the international model pages; prices from the China site in CNY (cn; DeepSeek-V4-Flash at its standard hours, 2:00-8:00 costs half) and the international model pages in USD (global).
